enrichment_method.evidence: The residual supernatant was incubated with pre-equilibrated anti-diGly antibody (32 μg/IP) conjugated to protein A agarose beads (PTMScan® Ub Remnant Motif Kit; Cell Signaling) at 4 °C for 1 h.

25 μL of Ubiquitin-Trap Magnetic Agarose beads (Proteintech) were added and the mixture was rotated at 4 °C for 80 min, before washing, once with 10 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% (v/v) NP-40, 0.5 mM EDTA and 3 M urea and twice with 10 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% (v/v) NP-40, 0.5 mM EDTA and elution in 40 μL of 4% (w/v) SDS in 50 mM Tris (pH 7.5) at RT, followed by concentration determination with a Pierce BCA Protein Assay Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

instrument.evidence: The extracted peptides were dried in a speed-vac and then resuspended in 2% (v/v) ACN, 0.1% (v/v) FA, and analyzed on an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer, coupled to a Dionex U3000 nanoHPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
